How MadRent Automated 60,000+ Outbound Minutes With an AI Voice Agent

When an inbound lead arrives, speed matters. When hundreds or thousands arrive, speed becomes an operational problem. That is exactly where MadRent, a South African vehicle rental company, found itself. Its team had been…

external.description: When an inbound lead arrives, speed matters. When hundreds or thousands arrive, speed becomes an operational problem. That is exactly where MadRent, a South African vehicle rental company, found itself. Its team had been manually qualifying every inbound lead by phone. The process worked, but there was a hard limit to how many calls five people could realistically handle. Instead of adding more people to make more calls, MadRent changed the role of its team. The company deployed CallHippo's AI Voice Agent for outbound lead qualification. The AI now handles the high-volume calling operation, while human representatives focus on the part of the sales process where human judgment has greater value: closing.
external.title: How MadRent Automated 60,000+ Outbound Minutes With an AI Voice Agent
